```artifact
Feature: Patient Management System

  As a healthcare professional, I want to manage patient details and appointments effectively.

  So that I can provide timely and accurate care to patients.

Scenario: Query and modify patient details
  Given a valid patient ID
  When I query the patient details
  Then I should see the patient's information
  And I should be able to modify the patient's details

  Examples:
    | Patient ID | Speciality | Symptoms | Appointment Date | Expected Result |
    | 12345      | Cardiology | Chest pain | 2023-04-15      | Successful update |
    | 67890      | Neurology  | Headache   | 2023-04-20      | Successful update |
    | 13579      | Dermatology| Rash      | 2023-04-25      | Successful update |

Scenario: Patient pin-code validation
  Given a patient ID
  When I attempt to modify the patient pin-code
  Then I should not be able to modify the pin-code outside the allowed zone
  And I should receive an error message

  Examples:
    | Patient ID | Pin-code | Expected Result |
    | 12345      | 1234     | Invalid pin-code |
    | 67890      | 6789     | Invalid pin-code |
    | 13579      | 1357     | Invalid pin-code |

Scenario: Create patient appointment
  Given a valid patient ID and next day's date
  When I enter the appointment details
  Then I should create a new appointment in the patient appointment file
  And I should receive a confirmation message

  Examples:
    | Patient ID | Speciality | Symptoms | Appointment Date | Expected Result |
    | 12345      | Cardiology | Chest pain | 2023-04-16      | Appointment created |
    | 67890      | Neurology  | Headache   | 2023-04-21      | Appointment created |
    | 13579      | Dermatology| Rash      | 2023-04-21      | Appointment created |

Scenario: Doctor consultation requests
  Given a valid patient ID
  When I view the consultation requests
  Then I should see all the requests
  And I should be able to select a request

  Examples:
    | Patient ID | Request Type | Expected Result |
    | 12345      | Consultation | All requests visible |
    | 67890      | Appointment   | All requests visible |
    | 13579      | Lab Test     | All requests visible |

Scenario: Doctor diagnosis and prescription
  Given a valid patient ID and a selected consultation request
  When I enter the diagnosis and prescription
  Then I should enter the diagnosis and prescription
  And I should be able to prescribe up to 8 medicines
  And I should be able to request up to 5 lab tests
  And I should receive a confirmation message

  Examples:
    | Patient ID | Diagnosis | Prescription | Lab Tests | Expected Result |
    | 12345      | Diagnosis1 | Prescription1 | Lab Test1 | Confirmation |
    | 67890      | Diagnosis2 | Prescription2 | Lab Test2 | Confirmation |
    | 13579      | Diagnosis3 | Prescription3 | Lab Test3 | Confirmation |

Scenario: Chemist medicines provision
  Given a valid patient ID and a prescription
  When I view the prescription
  Then I should see the prescription
  And I should be able to provide medicines
  And I should be able to mark the flag in prescription
  And I should receive a confirmation message

  Examples:
    | Patient ID | Prescription | Medicines | Expected Result |
    | 12345      | Prescription1 | Medicines1 | Confirmation |
    | 67890      | Prescription2 | Medicines2 | Confirmation |
    | 13579      | Prescription3 | Medicines3 | Confirmation |

Scenario: Lab test provision
  Given a valid patient ID and a prescription
  When I view the prescription
  Then I should see the prescription
  And I should be able to note the lab tests
  And I should be able to add the report
  And I should receive a confirmation message

  Examples:
    | Patient ID | Prescription | Lab Tests | Report | Expected Result |
    | 12345      | Prescription1 | Lab Test1 | Report1 | Confirmation |
    | 67890      | Prescription2 | Lab Test2 | Report2 | Confirmation |
    | 13579      | Prescription3 | Lab Test3 | Report3 | Confirmation |
